svg.aria-label: Three cooling choices as panels. Evaporative: less electricity but evaporates water on site, hard on dry towns. Closed loop: water filled once and recirculated, no evaporation for cooling, chillers use more power. Reclaimed or seawater: non-potable sources that need treatment and pipes, with outfalls and brine to manage.
svg.text: EVERY COOLING CHOICE IS A TRADE
qualitative · direction of the trade, not measured values
no free option: the bill moves between water, electricity, money and the local environment
